query: Across role, grade level, and subject, which open-response themes are associated with satisfaction?

per_column.name: teaching_approach
per_column.rationale: A genuine new axis for grouping open-response themes against satisfaction. However groundedness is shaky: ED-0001 (algebra with frozen whiteboard sharing) labeled 'active_interactive' and ED-0004 (recorded lectures) labeled 'mixed' when the text describes lecture/passive delivery; several labels are not clearly warranted by the text.

per_column.name: innovative_curriculum_adaptation
per_column.rationale: Useful thematic axis distinct from teaching approach. Values are well grounded: kitchen-chemistry -> high_innovation, silent-participation -> minimal_or_none, documentary clips -> moderate_adaptation are all sound readings.

per_column.name: student_engagement_level
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant to satisfaction analysis and clearly derivable: 'cries before every session'/'cameras off, silent' -> low_disengaged, 'show up on time with materials' -> high_engagement. Well warranted.

per_column.name: subject_remote_fit
per_column.rationale: Provides a subject-suitability axis useful for the query's subject dimension. Mostly grounded, though somewhat correlated with engagement; ED-0004's high_fit is a reasonable inference from positive self-paced remarks.

per_column.name: instructor_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Meaningful axis. Values track the text well: 'teacher can't tell when she's lost' -> slow_or_absent, silent for student rows -> null (correct silent handling). ED-0004 'highly_responsive' is a mild stretch but defensible.

judge.rationale: All five columns give genuine, non-redundant analytical axes (approach, innovation, engagement, subject fit, responsiveness) that directly support grouping open-response themes against satisfaction across role/grade/subject; none are near-constant or trivial. Groundedness is generally sound with correct 'unknown'/null handling for silent rows, but teaching_approach shows some labels contradicting the source text (recorded lectures tagged 'mixed', frozen-whiteboard algebra tagged 'active_interactive'), lowering overall groundedness slightly.
